_note: Reader-visible text, by key. crates/core/src/page.rs lists the keys the game reads; GLOSSARY.md defines each term a string uses.
title: CHUMWORLD
no_webgl: This game draws with WebGL 2, which this browser has turned off or does not have. Turn on hardware acceleration in the browser's settings, or open the page in a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
item_short_sword_about: Your own sword: {short_sword.blade} cm of blade, light and quick. It gives no bonus.
item_sword_about: A full {sword.blade} cm blade. It is heavy: a hard hit on a foe's blade can knock their weapon out of their hands.
item_boomerang_about: Thrown from the free hand, it flies out in an arc as far as {boomerang.reach} metres and comes back to you.
item_rock_about: Thrown from the free hand. A rock that lands on the merchant's cart stops the cart.
item_knife_about: A small blade, thrown from the free hand.
item_bandage_about: Wraps a wound and gives back {bandage.heals} health.
item_chest_key_about: Opens the chest at the bandit camp.
item_hood_about: One of {speedster.pieces} pieces of the speedster's armour, worn on the head. Each piece worn adds {speedster.speed_pct}% speed and makes your footing icier.
item_jacket_about: One of {speedster.pieces} pieces of the speedster's armour, worn on the body. Each piece worn adds {speedster.speed_pct}% speed and makes your footing icier.
item_gloves_about: One of {speedster.pieces} pieces of the speedster's armour, worn on the hands. Each piece worn adds {speedster.speed_pct}% speed and makes your footing icier.
item_trousers_about: One of {speedster.pieces} pieces of the speedster's armour, worn on the legs. Each piece worn adds {speedster.speed_pct}% speed and makes your footing icier.
item_boots_about: One of {speedster.pieces} pieces of the speedster's armour, worn on the feet. Each piece worn adds {speedster.speed_pct}% speed and makes your footing icier.
assign_hint: Press 1, 2 or 3 to put it on that key.
refuse_wear: The {item} is not worn: it is in Select Item.
hold_hint: Press Enter to hold it in your sword hand.
worn_hint: Worn. Press Enter to take it off.
map_legend: The map fills in where you walk.
imbue_known: Learned. Q imbues your sword for {imbue.seconds} seconds, so it can deflect magic. It is ready again {imbue.cooldown} seconds after the cast.
imbue_unknown: Not learned yet. The trainer in the hut on the hill teaches it.
quest_opening: Get out of the village. The orcs have taken it.
nothing_to_sell: You have no items to sell.
refuse_not_sold: The merchant has no {item} for sale.
refuse_coins: You need {n} more coins for the {item}.
refuse_full: You carry as many as you can hold: {n}.
refuse_keep: The merchant does not buy the {item}.
settings_note: Settings last until you close the page. No sound plays yet.
sample_line_1: You ran from the village with a short sword and no plan. Good. The running part, anyway.
sample_line_2: Before you cross blades with the bandits, learn to turn their magic aside. Stand there and watch the pattern.
_note_m4: M4 (task U): the menus, the HUD, dialogue, the shop and settings (crates/core/src/ui.rs). sample_line_1 and sample_line_2 are test lines for the dialogue box (act test.dialogue) until M5 writes the story's.
refuse_coins_one: You need {n} more coin for the {item}.
story_wake: Shouting outside. Orcs are in the village.
story_free: You got clear of the village. The orcs turn back.
story_came_to: You come to where you left the village. Your things are still with you.
story_full: You carry as many as you can hold.
story_cart_stopped: The cart stops. The merchant waits for you.
story_alarm: The lookout shouts. The camp is up.
story_camp_cleared: The camp is down. The leader dropped a key.
story_chest_locked: The chest is locked. The bandit leader has the key.
story_learned: You can imbue your sword now: Q.
quest_trainer: Find the trainer in the hut on the hill west of the river.
quest_camp: Clear the bandit camp in the north-east forest. Its chest holds a boomerang.
quest_speedster: Find the rest of the speedster's armour. The merchant sells one piece.
quest_done: You have every item in this region.
merchant_hello: You stopped my cart for a reason, I hope. Have a look.
trainer_1: So the orcs did not get you. Sit, if you like. Or learn something.
trainer_2: Magic flies in patterns. An imbued blade turns an orb aside, one orb at a time.
trainer_3: I will imbue your sword for this practice. Draw it with X, then swing through each orb I send.
trainer_draw: Draw your sword with X, and I begin.
trainer_again: Not yet. Watch the pattern, and swing through each orb as it comes.
trainer_pass_1: That is it. You turned them yourself.
trainer_pass_2: The imbue is yours now. Press Q and your sword turns magic for a while; then it needs time before the next.
trainer_done: Keep the blade moving. Magic does not wait for you.
refuse_sell_hand: The {item} is in your sword hand. Put another sword there in Equipment to sell this one.
refuse_sell_worn: You wear the {item}. Take it off in Equipment to sell it.
refuse_sell_quest: The merchant does not buy the {item}. There is no other to find.
refuse_purse: You can carry {n} coins at most. Spend some first.
story_purse_full: You can carry no more coins.
quick_ready: In play, {key} readies it in the free hand.
quick_use: In play, {key} uses it at once.
story_bandaged: You wrap the wound. Some health comes back.
story_bandage_kept: You are not hurt. The bandage keeps.
swing_how: Hold left button and move the mouse sideways for a level cut, up or down for a chop. Turn the wheel away for a thrust.
_m7_travel: M7 travel (P6, T11): the flute, the waystones, the traveller (crates/core/src/travel.rs)
item_flute_about: A carved wooden flute, the trainer's gift. Play it from its key, or here with Enter: the travel song takes you to a waystone you have woken.
travel_song_about: Play it on the flute, then choose a waystone you have woken: it takes you there.
flute_hint: Play notes with the arrows and Space. Esc puts the flute away.
flute_pick_hint: Choose with the arrows and Enter, or click a waystone.
flute_none_woken: No waystone is awake yet. Walk up to one and press E to wake it.
song_wrong: That is not a song you know. Play again.
traveller_hint: Choose a ride with the arrows and Enter, or click one. A place you have been is not on the list.
traveller_nowhere: You have been everywhere I go. Walk on, and mind the orcs.
traveller_hello: I go where you have not been yet, for coins. The farther, the dearer.
traveller_ride: Climb up behind the packs. It is a long road, so rest your eyes.
traveller_arrived: The traveller sets you down by the waystone and turns back. The waystone is awake.
travel_woke: The waystone wakes. Its marks glow, and your map shows it.
travel_refuse_opening: The flute cannot carry you out of the raid. Run past the village's edge first.
travel_refuse_duel: A foe is on you. Get clear of the fight, then play.
travel_refuse_busy: You are on your way already.
trainer_flute_1: One more thing. Take this flute. It carried me about these lands when I was young.
trainer_flute_2: Learn this song. Play it, and the flute takes you to a waystone you have woken.
trainer_flute_3: The waystones sleep until you touch one. There is one beside my hut: press E by it.
quest_flute: Press E by the waystone beside the trainer's hut to wake it. The travel song on the flute takes you back to a waystone you have woken.
wound_take_up: X · Take up your sword in your other hand
_roadside: M7 roadside (T12): the stops beside the ways out of the village
roadside_searched: You search the cart and take what is left in it.
roadside_drink: You drink from the well. Your health is whole again.
roadside_north_1: The orcs came up from the south. None of them followed us this far.
roadside_north_2: Keep on up the lane to the crossroads. The merchant's cart passes there, and a rock that lands on it stops it.
roadside_north_west_1: Keep on west and you come to the bridge over the river.
roadside_north_west_2: Past the bridge, a trail climbs the hill to the trainer's hut. The trainer can teach you to turn magic with your sword.
roadside_north_east_1: One orc stayed behind to pick over a cart. It set the cart alight.
roadside_north_east_2: Bandits camp in the forest to the north-east. Their lookout watches the trail.
roadside_west_1: West of here there is open grass, then the river.
roadside_west_2: For the bridge, go north-west. For the crossroads and the merchant's road, go north.
new_game_warn: A new game replaces your save. Once you start, the saved game is gone.
save_came_to: You come to at your save point, your things still with you. Foes you beat since you last saved stand again.
save_loaded_title: Save loaded. Continue to play it.
save_loaded: Save loaded. Resume to play it.
save_none: There is no save yet. The game saves once you leave the village.
save_none_stored: There is no save in this browser. Start a new game, or load a save file.
save_refused_start: The saved game was refused: {why} A new game starts.
save_refused_file: That file was refused: {why} Your game is as it was.
save_why_unreadable: it is not a save file.
save_why_format: it is a file of another kind, not this game's save.
save_why_version: it is from another version of the game.
save_why_checksum: it has been changed since it was written.
save_why_field: its "{field}" is not what a save holds.
save_why_route: it holds the {item} without the way to get it.
save_refuse_opening: Not saved: get clear of the village first.
save_refuse_duel: Not saved: a foe is on you. Get clear of the fight, then save.
save_refuse_busy: Not saved: wait until you are on your feet.
save_refuse_staged: Not saved: this game was set up from the address for a test.
place_save_trail: Save point on the camp trail
